assessment_model.implementation_level: highest level supported by code and local control-plane behavior
assessment_model.evidence_level: highest level supported by source/test/runtime/field evidence; must not exceed implementation level
assessment_model.effective_level: minimum of implementation_level and evidence_level; all public maturity claims use effective_level

status_semantics.verified: implementation_level equals evidence_level and the claimed effective level has no open evidence gap
status_semantics.verified_local: the effective level is supported locally, while an explicitly documented runtime, remote, operator, or field gap remains
status_semantics.partially_verified: some evidence exists, but the evidence needed for the next claimed layer or capability is incomplete
